checkpoints.name: mss_loglog_lower
checkpoints.description: Section 3.4 of BCR23 (arXiv 2211.05753v2): there are c > 0 and n0 such that for all n >= n0 there is an n-point metric space and a start point admitting a distributional lower bound c (log2 n / log2 log2 n)^2 for small-set chasing — the basic-construction form of the paper's refutation of the randomized k-server conjecture (the full Omega(log^2 k) needs the Section 4 compression, not part of this task). See tests/reference/concept-ledger.md.
